_comment: Names that appear in some investor's track_record.notable_investments[] but
are NOT profileable operating companies, so they should not sit in the
company backlog inviting research that can only end in a `skipped` entry.
* the name is an INVESTOR, not a company (an investor listing another
investor as a notable investment is a data slip on the investor side,
but the name still shows up as an unresolved portfolio company)
* the name is a FUND VEHICLE or a FACILITY rather than an organization
* the company is real but NOT MEDICAL, so it fails this directory's bar
Each entry needs a reason. This is a research-scope decision, not a data
correction: the investor records that name these are left untouched, since
a fund genuinely did back them and deleting that would lose a real fact.
Only the backlog — the list of things worth researching — is filtered.
Matching is on the normalized name, so script and punctuation variants of
the same name are covered by one entry.

not_a_company.Flagship Pioneering: A venture-creation firm, already catalogued as an investor (us-flagship-pioneering). Named as a portfolio company by two investors, which is a slip on their side.
not_a_company.Brandon Capital BB6 Fund: A fund vehicle of Brandon Capital (anz-brandon-capital), not an operating company.
not_a_company.Forbion Capital Fund III: A fund vehicle of Forbion, not an operating company.
not_a_company.Sanofi (Toronto flu vaccine facility): A manufacturing facility of an already-catalogued pharma company, not a distinct legal entity.
not_a_company.Kyulux: Real company, but OLED emitter materials — a Kyushu University spinout with no medical business. Fails the directory's medical bar.
not_a_company.BioLumic: Real company, but agricultural UV seed treatment. No human-health application.
not_a_company.Qover: Generalist embedded-insurance provider; health is one product line among several rather than its focus.
